title: EOES official task-marking and ranking protocol

competition_format.task_character: integrated experimental assignments emphasizing biology, chemistry, physics, practical work, measurements, analysis, and teamwork

scoring_protocol: Score each task against its edition-specific official marking scheme and answer sheet.
Add the two task scores to obtain the team total.
Rank official teams by descending total score.
Apply only the medal decisions and guest-team status published for that edition.

applicability.scope: EOES and predecessor EUSO tasks represented in the local dataset.
applicability.task_specificity: Question-level criteria and points are edition- and task-specific; the matching official marking scheme controls.
applicability.guest_teams: Guest teams may be outside the official ranking, as stated in the applicable edition results.

provenance.title: EOES documents
supports: official rules, regulations, guidelines, and syllabus provenance
question-level point labels for some editions

limitations: There is no edition-independent numeric rubric for EOES; each official marking scheme defines its own question-level points.
Exact totals are recorded only for editions verified from official published result tables.
The local benchmark does not consistently include every official marking scheme, and benchmark total_points fields are null.
Medal cutoffs or quotas are not inferred from result tables.
